objectives.title: Launch
objectives.hint: Pick a rocket in the assembly building (Luma Pathfinder is ready to fly), press Launch, then Space to ignite. Z = full throttle.

objectives.title: Reach space ({space} km)
objectives.hint: At ~60 m/s tap D to tip ~10° east, then select SAS Prograde. Stage (Space) when engines burn out.

objectives.title: Achieve a stable orbit
objectives.hint: Cut throttle when apoapsis is ~{space+10} km. In the map (M) click your orbit at Ap, drag the prograde handle until Pe > {space} km, then SAS → Maneuver and burn when the timer reaches 0.

objectives.title: Plan a transfer to {moon}
objectives.hint: In the map click {moon} → Set as target. Add a node on your orbit and drag prograde (~860 m/s) and move it along the orbit until a {moon} encounter appears.

objectives.title: Enter {moon}'s sphere of influence
objectives.hint: Execute the transfer burn, then time warp (.) — warp stops automatically near dangerous events.

objectives.title: Orbit {moon}
objectives.hint: Add a node at the {moon} periapsis and drag retrograde until the orbit closes; burn.

objectives.title: Land on {moon}
objectives.hint: Deploy legs (G). Burn retrograde to drop periapsis below the surface, then use SAS Retrograde (surface speed) and throttle to touch down below 3 m/s.

objectives.title: Walk on {moon} (EVA)
objectives.hint: Right-click the capsule → EVA. WASD to walk, Space to jump, R for the jetpack.

objectives.title: Plant a flag
objectives.hint: Stand on the ground and press G.

objectives.title: Board the lander
objectives.hint: Fly or walk to within 3 m of the hatch (jetpack R, Shift up) and press B.

objectives.title: Launch from {moon} back to orbit
objectives.hint: Retract legs (G), full throttle, tip east and follow prograde until Ap ~20 km; circularise with a node.

objectives.title: Return to {home}
objectives.hint: Plan a node on the far side of {moon} and burn prograde until the trajectory returns to {home} with periapsis ~30 km.

objectives.title: Survive reentry
objectives.hint: Decouple the lander (Space), hold SAS Retrograde so the heat shield faces the airflow.

objectives.title: Land safely
objectives.hint: Stage the parachute; it waits for safe pressure and opens fully at 1 km. Touch down under 6 m/s.

objectives.title: Recover the capsule
objectives.hint: Press Esc → Recover vessel once landed or splashed down.
